headline: Political Dispute Follows PM Narendra Modi's Nitish Setu Inauguration
seoTitle: Narendra Modi Inaugurates Nitish Setu Bridge In Bihar
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Nitish Setu in Vaishali, sparking political friction and disputes over credit for the new bridge project.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the new Nitish Setu bridge linking Patna and Vaishali districts in Bihar.
The project, costing ₹5,500 crore, has become the center of a political dispute regarding credit and the bridge's naming.
Opposition workers reportedly removed banners of the Prime Minister and the Bihar Chief Minister at the site following the event.
aiContextParagraph: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently inaugurated the Nitish Setu, a significant infrastructure project in Bihar designed to connect the Patna and Vaishali districts. The inauguration, which was part of a broader launch of several development projects valued at ₹5,500 crore, has triggered a notable political controversy. Various factions are currently disputing the credit for the bridge's completion, with claims emerging from the Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) and criticism leveled by Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) officials regarding the naming of the structure after Chief Minister Nitish Kumar. Additionally, reports indicate that RJD workers removed promotional materials at the site following the ceremony. Observers and political figures have offered differing perspectives on the origins of the infrastructure project, reflecting ongoing tensions within the region's political landscape regarding development initiatives and state governance.
whyItIsViral: The event is trending due to widespread coverage by four major outlets and significant public search interest in Prime Minister Narendra Modi following the inauguration and subsequent political protests.
